g.text: F5 · Canonical fixed-time results on matched roots

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Original 200/800 ms runs; identical 2,437 IDs. One paired discordance at 200 ms (p=1); both perfect at 800 ms.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Actual early stopping and skewed visit distributions are retained in T6. This does not establish a strength gain.
